audit.whatIsWrong: Marked FAV but rated 8.5/10 difficulty, and the chart gave Skill at Levels 4-5 and first item while giving Gwen the 2+ item row the prose says she loses.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Yorick on a 55.44% win rate; the prose says 'You can't win that splitpush'.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 4/10 to match FAV, chart realigned in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text with no timings.
audit.why: Gwen's spikes are Level 2-3, Level 6 Mist and Riftmaker; Yorick's is a permanent Maiden at two items. Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s, Mourning Mist 12-8s, Last Rites 6-4s.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is treated as something you can only dodge, Mourning Mist's armour shred is never mentioned, and Last Rites' heal is never called out despite _missing-interactions.json flagging this matchup for Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot on Dark Procession: 'Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location' — you can break a segment out, which changes the whole response to being caged. Riot on Mourning Mist: it 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets' — the mark is what makes the swarm dangerous, and it also cuts your armour. Riot on Last Rites: 'Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug' — it is a 4-6s auto-reset that both sustains him and creates the graves his Mist Walkers spawn from, so denying graves denies the swarm.
audit.corrected: Destructibility, the mark-and-armour-shred, and the grave economy plus Grievous Wounds all written in.

audit.why: Dark Procession 20/18/16/14/12s, Mourning Mist 12/11/10/9/8s, Last Rites 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s.
audit.corrected: All written into the cooldown block and phase whys.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Yorick is a slow starter and so are you, but level 1 he has no ghoul graves and no Dark Procession cage, so you can step up and Snip him whenever he comes to last-hit. From level 2 don't waste your Q on his ghouls — they melt your mist but your %-max-HP Snip ignores them and chunks HIS bar, so always aim the center snip through the swarm at Yorick himself. Respect his Mourning Mist (E): it slows and marks you so every ghoul pounces, and dodge the Dark Procession (W) wall — if it cages you onto the ghoul pile you eat the whole army, so keep it on your screen and walk out the open side before committing.
edits.after: Yorick is a slow starter and so are you, but level 1 he has no ghoul graves and no Dark Procession cage, so you can step up and Snip him whenever he comes to last-hit. From level 2 don't waste your Q on his ghouls — your %-max-HP Snip ignores them and chunks HIS bar, so always aim the center snip through the swarm at Yorick himself. Respect his Mourning Mist (E): it cuts your armour, slows, and marks you so every summon sprints at the mark. And the Dark Procession (W) wall is destructible — if it cages you onto the ghoul pile, break a segment out rather than eating the whole army.

notes: Rated FAV but carrying an 8.5/10 difficulty score, which reads as a hard lane on a 55.44% win rate; corrected to 4/10. The three facts that change how the lane is played — Dark Procession is destructible, Mourning Mist cuts armour and is what accelerates the swarm, and Last Rites is both the heal (Grievous Wounds target) and the grave generator — were all missing.
